title: AC1018 TABLE exact default plot-style graph closure
question: Can an AC1018 TABLE's non-default plot-style handle be admitted only when the emitted object is the exact placeholder in the writer's staged default plot-style graph?

finding.before: The TABLE direct codec serialized a positive plot-style handle, but hasClosedAc1018TableBlockGraph did not verify its identity or target graph. A preceding guard rejected all positive handles, which unnecessarily excluded the writer's existing opt-in default plot-style graph.
finding.change: Direct TABLE encoding again preserves the common-header hard pointer. Compound graph admission accepts a non-default plotStyle only when it equals m_defaultPlotStylePlaceholderHandle, the default graph is marked emitted, and that exact placeholder handle has an emitted object frame. Other positive handles are refused.
finding.control: The generated whole-file graph vector sets a dangling plot-style handle and verifies graph-closure refusal, then restores the original value. The direct-codec vector confirms a positive plot-style handle remains serializable for outer graph validation.
finding.scope: This connects the TABLE gate to the existing staged default plot-style provider graph. It does not authorize arbitrary plot-style objects or establish native semantics.
finding.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; controls use generated in-memory objects.

validation.result: PASS: AC1018 TABLE encoder allocation failures injected=19 rollback=PASS retry=PASS; AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell override vectors: PASS

limitations: The test proves refusal of an arbitrary dangling plot-style handle, not successful full-document TABLE output using the provider graph.
Exact provider-graph success and native consumer semantics remain qualification work.
